field_mappings.transformation: Parse the whole native abn cell as an Australian Business Number, accepting only values whose type label or checksum validates as an ABN, and emit the 11-digit ABN; invalid, 8-digit, or 9-digit values are not emitted as ABNs.

unmapped_fields.reason: The source header is generic contractor wording and no source documentation defines it as the registered legal name; trading-style 't/a' text also shows the value may not be a legal name in every row, so no entity.legal_name mapping is supported.
Free-text description of the contract; it is not a legal name, address, or other canonical entity field.
Confidentiality flag about the contract record; no canonical ontology field applies.
Contract monetary amount; the ontology has no contract value field.
Contract reference number; it identifies the contract, not the business entity, and has no canonical field.
Contract title; it describes the contract and is not a registered legal name.
Government directorate or agency responsible for the contract; it is not a business subject in the ontology.
Contract execution date; it is not a registration date, observation time, or whole-observation validity date under the ontology.
Procurement exemption flag; no canonical ontology field applies.
Contract expiry date; it is not an entity status or whole-observation validity date under the ontology.
GST treatment of the contract amount; no canonical ontology field applies.
Goods or services classification of the procurement; no canonical ontology field applies.
Internal matrix reference number; no canonical ontology field applies.
Panel contract flag; no canonical ontology field applies.
Panel contract reference number; no canonical ontology field applies.
Panel total amount; no canonical ontology field applies.
Prior department or agency; it is a government body reference and not a business entity field under the ontology.
Procurement method; no canonical ontology field applies.
Procurement type classification; no canonical ontology field applies.
SME flag about the contract; no canonical ontology field applies.
Social procurement flag; no canonical ontology field applies.
Source row identifier; it is native record traceability metadata and not a canonical business field.
Tender reference number; no canonical ontology field applies.
UNSPSC classification of the contract; the ontology's industry_code is ANZSIC, so no supported mapping exists.
Pre-qualification flag for the selection process; no canonical ontology field applies.
